feats.title: Action Surge
feats.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls you make during any action you gain by spending an action point.

feats.title: Human Perseverance
feats.description: You gain +1 healing surge and a +1 racial bonus to saving throws.

feats.title: Human Resolve
feats.description: You gain 3 + one-half your level temporary hit points whenever you spend an Action Point.

feats.title: Stubborn Survivor
feats.description: You gain a +2 bonus to saving throws whenever you have no action points remaining.

feats.title: Die Hard
feats.description: When you have failed two death saving throws since your last rest, you gain a +5 feat bonus to death saving throws and can spend a healing surge on a result of 15 or higher. If you have no healing surges, your condition does not change.

feats.title: Quick To Action
feats.description: You gain a +2 bonus to Initiative. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while bloodied.

feats.title: Still a Threat
feats.description: While you are dazed, you can still flank enemies and take opportunity actions.
